observations_used: Explicit ripple16 produced by far the lowest observed area and power, but substantially worse timing.
prefix16 approached the high-timing frontier but required considerably more area than ripple16.
The partition-based carry-select designs occupy useful intermediate area/timing points.
prefix8_select8 and cla4x4 were dominated by previously measured structures.
hypothesis: A hybrid with an explicit ripple low-order region and a faster high-order carry mechanism may bridge the large gap between ripple16 and the high-timing designs.
